strings.evidence.heading: What the satellites see at the farm
strings.evidence.veg.heading: Greenness through the year (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI is a number for how green the land looks from space. Near 0.1 means bare ground. 0.6 or more means thick green plants. It shows when the land near the farm is covered with plants and when it is bare.
strings.evidence.veg.low: Least green months (the land is most bare): {months}.
strings.evidence.veg.season: Season {season} ({months}): average NDVI {mean}, in a dry year {p20}, in a wet year {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: The greenest months fall inside our season windows and the land is least green in January to March, before planting. But the curve stays flat between the two seasons, so greenness alone cannot separate them.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: The greenest months do not match our season windows. Check the windows with a local farmer or crop calendar.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Each square of the satellite picture is about 6 ha. This farm is 2 ha. So the picture also includes the land around the farm. Trees or banana next to the field can hide the bare times. Clouds leave gaps. Only the farmer knows what is growing in the field.
strings.evidence.veg.source: Source: NASA MODIS, 250 m, every 16 days, {start} to {end}.
strings.evidence.terrain.heading: The lie of the land
strings.evidence.terrain.position: Where the farm sits on the land
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: No danger here: the coldest night in 25 years stayed above 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: The height map is made of 30 m squares. This 2 ha farm covers only a few squares. It shows the shape of the land, not small dips or ridges in your field.
strings.evidence.footprint: We assume the farm is a 140 m square centred on the farm point.
strings.evidence.pos.high: high ground: rain water flows away from the farm
strings.evidence.pos.low: low ground: rain water from higher land may gather here
strings.evidence.pos.mid: middle of a slope: not clearly high or low
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Three rainfall estimates compared
strings.evidence.rain.note: Three different ways of measuring the rain at the farm. NASA POWER and ERA5 are computer weather records, and they agree closely. GPM IMERG is measured from satellites and shows more rain. We do not know which one is right for this farm. A rain gauge (a cup that catches rain) would show it. So the app shows all three.
strings.evidence.rain.col.et0: Water the sun and wind can dry up (ET0)
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 is how much water the sun and wind can dry up in one season from green grass that has all the water it needs. A crop uses a share of this amount. If ET0 is more than the rain, the crops depend on water stored in the soil.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Sources: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, via Open-Meteo; ET0 computed by Open-Meteo).
strings.evidence.field.heading: On the farm square itself (30 m)
strings.evidence.field.what: Landsat can see details of 30 m, so it can look at a 140 m square about the size of this farm. Green bars show how green that square is. Grey bars show the wider area seen by MODIS, for comparison.
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: How often the farm square looks bare, by month
strings.evidence.field.bare_what: Share of clear satellite pictures in which the land looked bare (NDVI below 0.25).
strings.evidence.field.least: Least green months on the farm square: {months}.
strings.evidence.field.thin: Few clear pictures (fewer than 8) in: {months}. Use those months with care.
strings.evidence.field.season: Season {season}: average NDVI {mean}; bare in {bare} % of clear pictures.
strings.evidence.field.source: Source: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 and 9, 30 m, {clear} clear pictures, {start} to {end}.
strings.evidence.field.limit: The 140 m square is our guess, not a measured boundary. Clouds remove many pictures in the rainy months. NDVI cannot tell which crop is growing or why land is bare.

strings.evidence.veg.heading: Obuddugavu bw'ebimera mu mwaka (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI nnamba eraga ettaka engeri gye lirabika nga limuddugavu n'ebimera nga lirabibwa okuva waggulu. Nga 0.1 kitegeeza ettaka nga terina kimera. 0.6 oba okusingawo kitegeeza ebimera bingi. Eraga ddi ettaka okumpi n'ennimiro lwe liba nga lirina ebimera n'ddi lwe liba nga terina.

strings.evidence.veg.season: Ekiseera {season} ({months}): NDVI eya wakati {mean}, mu mwaka omukalu {p20}, mu mwaka ogw'enkuba ennyingi {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: Emyezi egy'ebimera ebingi giri mu biseera byaffe era ettaka lisinga obutaba na kimera okuva mu January okutuuka mu March, nga tennasimbibwa. Naye olukoba luba lugonvu wakati w'ebiseera ebibiri, kale obuddugavu bwokka tebuyinza kubyawula.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: Emyezi egy'ebimera ebingi tegikwatagana n'ebiseera byaffe. Bikebere ne omulimi w'omu kitundu oba kalenda y'ebirime.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Buli kisenge ky'ekifaananyi kya satellite kiri nga yekita 6. Ennimiro eno yekita 2. Kale ekifaananyi kirimu n'ettaka eririraanyewo. Emiti oba ebitooke ebiriraanye ennimiro bisobola okukweka ebiseera ettaka we liba nga terina kimera. Ebire bireka ebituli. Omulimi yekka ye amanyi ekiri mu nnimiro.

strings.evidence.terrain.heading: Engeri ettaka gye liri
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: Tewali kabi wano: ekiro ekisinga okuba eky'obutiti mu myaka 25 tekyakka wansi wa 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: Maapu y'obuwanvu ekoleddwa mu bisenge bya mita 30. Ennimiro eno eya yekita 2 ejjuza bisenge bitono bwokka. Eraga engeri ettaka gye liri, so si bifo bitono ebikka oba ebitumbiddwa mu nnimiro yo.
strings.evidence.footprint: Tulowooza nti ennimiro kisenge kya mita 140 ekiri wakati w'ekifo ky'ennimiro.
strings.evidence.pos.high: ekifo ekigulumivu: amazzi g'enkuba gadduka okuva ku nnimiro
strings.evidence.pos.low: ekifo ekiri wansi: amazzi g'enkuba okuva waggulu gayinza okukuŋŋaanira wano
strings.evidence.pos.mid: wakati mu kikka: si kigulumivu so si kiwonvu nnyo
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Ebigeraageranyo bisatu eby'enkuba
strings.evidence.rain.note: Engeri ssatu ez'enjawulo ez'okupima enkuba ku nnimiro. NASA POWER ne ERA5 mpapula za mbeera y'obudde ezikoleddwa kompyuta, era zikwatagana nnyo. GPM IMERG epimibwa okuva mu satellite era eraga enkuba nnyingi. Tetumanyi ekituufu ku nnimiro eno. Ekipima enkuba (ekikopo ekikwata enkuba) kyandikiraze. Kale app eraga zonna ssatu.
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 bw'omuwendo gw'amazzi enjuba n'embuyaga by'esobola okukaza mu kiseera kimu okuva ku muddo omubisi oguliko amazzi gonna ge gwetaaga. Ekirime kikozesa ekitundu ky'omuwendo guno. ET0 bw'eba waggulu w'enkuba, ebirime byesigama ku mazzi agali mu ttaka.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Ensibuko: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, ng'eyita mu Open-Meteo; ET0 ebabaliddwa Open-Meteo).
strings.evidence.field.heading: Ku kisenge ky'ennimiro yennyini (mita 30)
strings.evidence.field.what: Landsat esobola okulaba ebitono eby'omita 30, kale esobola okutunuulira ekisenge kya mita 140 ekyenkana ennimiro eno. Emiguwa emiddugavu giraga ekisenge ekyo engeri gye kiri ekiddugavu n'ebimera. Emiguwa egya kyenvu giraga ekitundu ekigazi ekirabibwa MODIS, okugeraageranya.
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: Emirundi ekisenge ky'ennimiro lwe kiba nga tekirina kimera, buli mwezi

strings.evidence.heading: Kile ambacho satelaiti zinaona shambani
strings.evidence.veg.heading: Ukijani katika mwaka (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI ni namba inayoonyesha ardhi inaonekanaje kijani kutoka angani. Karibu 0.1 ni ardhi tupu. 0.6 au zaidi ni mimea mingi ya kijani. Inaonyesha ni lini ardhi karibu na shamba ina mimea na ni lini iko tupu.
strings.evidence.veg.low: Miezi yenye ukijani kidogo zaidi (ardhi iko tupu zaidi): {months}.
strings.evidence.veg.season: Msimu {season} ({months}): NDVI ya wastani {mean}, mwaka mkavu {p20}, mwaka wenye mvua nyingi {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: Miezi yenye ukijani zaidi iko ndani ya madirisha yetu ya misimu, na ardhi ina ukijani kidogo zaidi kuanzia Januari hadi Machi, kabla ya kupanda. Hata hivyo mkunjo unabaki tambarare kati ya misimu miwili, kwa hiyo ukijani peke yake hauwezi kuitenganisha.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: Miezi yenye ukijani zaidi haiendani na madirisha yetu ya misimu. Yahakikishe na mkulima wa eneo hilo au kalenda ya mazao.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Kila mraba wa picha ya satelaiti ni takriban hekta 6. Shamba hili ni hekta 2. Kwa hiyo picha inajumuisha pia ardhi inayozunguka shamba. Miti au migomba karibu na shamba vinaweza kuficha nyakati za ardhi tupu. Mawingu huacha mapengo. Ni mkulima pekee anayejua kinachokua shambani.
strings.evidence.veg.source: Chanzo: NASA MODIS, mita 250, kila siku 16, {start} hadi {end}.
strings.evidence.terrain.heading: Hali ya ardhi
strings.evidence.terrain.elevation: Kimo juu ya usawa wa bahari
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: Hakuna hatari hapa: usiku wenye baridi zaidi katika miaka 25 ulibaki juu ya 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: Ramani ya miinuko imetengenezwa kwa miraba ya mita 30. Shamba hili la hekta 2 linajaza miraba michache tu. Inaonyesha umbo la ardhi, si mashimo madogo au matuta ndani ya shamba lako.
strings.evidence.footprint: Tunadhani shamba ni mraba wa mita 140 uliowekwa katikati ya eneo la shamba.
strings.evidence.pos.high: mahali palipoinuka: maji ya mvua yanatiririka kutoka shambani
strings.evidence.pos.low: mahali pa chini: maji ya mvua kutoka mahali pa juu yanaweza kukusanyika hapa
strings.evidence.pos.mid: katikati ya mteremko: si juu wala chini dhahiri
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Makadirio matatu ya mvua yalinganishwa
strings.evidence.rain.note: Njia tatu tofauti za kupima mvua shambani. NASA POWER na ERA5 ni kumbukumbu za hali ya hewa zilizotengenezwa na kompyuta, na zinakaribiana sana. GPM IMERG inapimwa kutoka kwa satelaiti na inaonyesha mvua zaidi. Hatujui ni ipi sahihi kwa shamba hili. Kipimo cha mvua (kikombe kinachokusanya mvua) kingeonyesha. Kwa hiyo programu inaonyesha zote tatu.
strings.evidence.rain.col.et0: Maji ambayo jua na upepo vinaweza kukausha (ET0)
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 ni kiasi cha maji ambacho jua na upepo vinaweza kukausha katika msimu mmoja kutoka kwenye nyasi za kijani zenye maji yote zinayohitaji. Zao hutumia sehemu ya kiasi hiki. Ikiwa ET0 ni zaidi ya mvua, mazao hutegemea maji yaliyohifadhiwa ardhini.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Vyanzo: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, kupitia Open-Meteo; ET0 imekokotolewa na Open-Meteo).
strings.evidence.field.heading: Kwenye mraba wa shamba lenyewe (mita 30)
strings.evidence.field.what: Landsat huona maelezo ya mita 30, kwa hiyo inaweza kutazama mraba wa mita 140 wa ukubwa wa shamba hili. Nguzo za kijani zinaonyesha mraba huo una kijani kiasi gani. Nguzo za kijivu zinaonyesha eneo pana linaloonekana na MODIS, kwa kulinganisha.
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: Mara ngapi mraba wa shamba unaonekana tupu, kwa mwezi
strings.evidence.field.bare_what: Sehemu ya picha safi za satelaiti ambapo ardhi ilionekana tupu (NDVI chini ya 0.25).
strings.evidence.field.least: Miezi yenye ukijani kidogo zaidi kwenye mraba wa shamba: {months}.
strings.evidence.field.thin: Picha safi chache (chini ya 8) katika: {months}. Tumia miezi hiyo kwa uangalifu.
strings.evidence.field.season: Msimu {season}: NDVI ya wastani {mean}; tupu katika asilimia {bare} ya picha safi.
strings.evidence.field.source: Chanzo: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 na 9, mita 30, picha safi {clear}, {start} hadi {end}.
strings.evidence.field.limit: Mraba wa mita 140 ni makadirio yetu, si mpaka uliopimwa. Mawingu huondoa picha nyingi katika miezi ya mvua. NDVI haiwezi kusema ni zao gani linakua wala kwa nini ardhi ni tupu.

strings.evidence.heading: What the satellites see at the farm
strings.evidence.veg.heading: Greenness through the year (NDVI)
strings.evidence.veg.what: NDVI is a number for how green the land looks from space. Near 0.1 means bare ground. 0.6 or more means thick green plants. It shows when the land near the farm is covered with plants and when it is bare.
strings.evidence.veg.low: Least green months (the land is most bare): {months}.
strings.evidence.veg.season: Season {season} ({months}): average NDVI {mean}, in a dry year {p20}, in a wet year {p80}.
strings.evidence.veg.check_ok: The greenest months fall inside our season windows and the land is least green in January to March, before planting. But the curve stays flat between the two seasons, so greenness alone cannot separate them.
strings.evidence.veg.check_off: The greenest months do not match our season windows. Check the windows with a local farmer or crop calendar.
strings.evidence.veg.limit: Each square of the satellite picture is about 6 ha. This farm is 2 ha. So the picture also includes the land around the farm. Trees or banana next to the field can hide the bare times. Clouds leave gaps. Only the farmer knows what is growing in the field.
strings.evidence.veg.source: Source: NASA MODIS, 250 m, every 16 days, {start} to {end}.
strings.evidence.terrain.heading: The lie of the land
strings.evidence.terrain.position: Where the farm sits on the land
strings.evidence.terrain.frost_none: No danger here: the coldest night in 25 years stayed above 14 °C.
strings.evidence.terrain.limit: The height map is made of 30 m squares. This 2 ha farm covers only a few squares. It shows the shape of the land, not small dips or ridges in your field.
strings.evidence.footprint: We assume the farm is a 140 m square centred on the farm point.
strings.evidence.pos.high: high ground: rain water flows away from the farm
strings.evidence.pos.low: low ground: rain water from higher land may gather here
strings.evidence.pos.mid: middle of a slope: not clearly high or low
strings.evidence.rain.heading: Three rainfall estimates compared
strings.evidence.rain.note: Three different ways of measuring the rain at the farm. NASA POWER and ERA5 are computer weather records, and they agree closely. GPM IMERG is measured from satellites and shows more rain. We do not know which one is right for this farm. A rain gauge (a cup that catches rain) would show it. So the app shows all three.
strings.evidence.rain.col.et0: Water the sun and wind can dry up (ET0)
strings.evidence.rain.et0_note: ET0 is how much water the sun and wind can dry up in one season from green grass that has all the water it needs. A crop uses a share of this amount. If ET0 is more than the rain, the crops depend on water stored in the soil.
strings.evidence.rain.source: Sources: NASA POWER, NASA GPM IMERG, ERA5 (ECMWF, via Open-Meteo; ET0 computed by Open-Meteo).
strings.evidence.field.heading: On the farm square itself (30 m)
strings.evidence.field.what: Landsat can see details of 30 m, so it can look at a 140 m square about the size of this farm. Green bars show how green that square is. Grey bars show the wider area seen by MODIS, for comparison.
strings.evidence.field.bare_heading: How often the farm square looks bare, by month
strings.evidence.field.bare_what: Share of clear satellite pictures in which the land looked bare (NDVI below 0.25).
strings.evidence.field.least: Least green months on the farm square: {months}.
strings.evidence.field.thin: Few clear pictures (fewer than 8) in: {months}. Use those months with care.
strings.evidence.field.season: Season {season}: average NDVI {mean}; bare in {bare} % of clear pictures.
strings.evidence.field.source: Source: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 and 9, 30 m, {clear} clear pictures, {start} to {end}.
strings.evidence.field.limit: The 140 m square is our guess, not a measured boundary. Clouds remove many pictures in the rainy months. NDVI cannot tell which crop is growing or why land is bare.
strings.sms.c.water: Careful ({scenario}): {crop} may get only {pct}% of the water it needs ({when}).
strings.sms.c.dry_spell: Careful ({scenario}): {days} days without rain is too long for {crop} ({when}).
strings.sms.c.waterlog: Careful ({scenario}): too much rain may flood {crop} ({when}).
strings.sms.c.nitrogen: Careful: this plan uses up plant food (nitrogen) in the soil.
strings.sms.c.rotation: Careful: this plan grows the same kind of crop too often.
strings.nav.simulator: Try the phone simulator (USSD and SMS)
strings.sms.try: Try it yourself: open the phone simulator, dial *384*2026# and read the texts that arrive.

evidence.footprint_note: Farm boundary assumed: a 140 m square (about 2 ha) centred on the farm point.

vegetation.dataset: NASA MODIS Terra+Aqua MOD13Q1/MYD13Q1 v061, NDVI, 250 m, 16-day
vegetation.access: Microsoft Planetary Computer (public STAC, no login)
vegetation.footprint_note: A MODIS pixel is 250 m (about 6 ha); the pilot farm (2 ha, assumed 140 m square) is smaller, so this is the greenness of the farm and its neighbours together. Neighbouring perennial cover can hide bare-field periods.

field.dataset: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 and 9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance, 30 m
field.access: Microsoft Planetary Computer (public STAC, no login)
field.limit_note: The farm square (140 m) is assumed. Clouds remove many scenes in the rainy months, so months with few clear looks are less certain.

rain_sources.dataset: ERA5 reanalysis, 0.25 deg, via Open-Meteo archive API

terrain.dataset: NASADEM (NASA reprocessed SRTM), 1 arc-second (~30 m), elevations from the 2000 shuttle mission
terrain.access: Microsoft Planetary Computer (public STAC, no login)
terrain.farm_footprint: 5 x 5 cells (~155 m square, assumed 140 m)

landscape_position.reading: high ground: water drains away from the farm

frost.note: Not applicable here: the farm is about 1.7 deg N at ~1,100 m; see POWER minimum temperatures.

terrain.limits: At 30 m the farm is a handful of cells: this is landscape context, not a field survey. SRTM dates from 2000 and sees treetops and buildings.
